levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: Two routes («رويته عن» twice) to Muhammad b. Aslam, each written in full; their last names repeat, so no shared tail
«خادم الرضا عليه السلام» is an epithet on Muhammad b. Zayd, left out; «ما كان فيه» is the topic of the report, not a link
The bare «أبي» is a relation link with no name, as written
